Kit summary

Decoding AttackBasic
Deals 360% DEF DMG to a single enemy. Deals extra 45% (up to 225%) DEF DMG and restores self HP by the same amount for every 1 type of Debuff the target has. The extra DMG ignores DEF.
Genetic ShockActiveExclusive Lv.1
Deals 400% DEF DMG to a single enemy, with a 100% chance to reduce the target's ATK by 40% for 2 turns.
Gear Axe Lv.1Genetic Shock increases the duration of the target's ATK reduction to 3 turns, with the same chance to reduce the target's Crit Rate by 50% for 3 turns.
Self-maintenancePassiveExclusive Lv.2
When taking Fatal DMG, HAL9000 is immune to death and removes allies' [Ally Protection] granted by him immediately. At the end of the turn during which this effect is triggered, restores self HP by 30% of his Max HP and enters [Repair] status for 4 turns. When HAL9000 is under [Repair] status, reduces his Direct DMG and DoT taken by 40%, but the death immunity of Self-maintenance cannot be triggered and Protection System cannot be cast.
Gear Axe Lv.2While HAL9000 is under [Repair] status, restores self HP by 4% of his Max HP at the end of allies' (excluding self) turn. HAL9000 gains 1 layer of [Fix] at the end of all allies' and enemies' turns. Consumes all layers of [Fix] immediately to reduce the duration of [Repair] by 1 turn when he has 6 layers of [Fix].
Protection SystemActiveExclusive Lv.3
Grants all allies (excluding self) [Ally Protection] for HAL9000's 4 turns. HAL9000 takes 50% of DMG dealt to allies with [Ally Protection] granted by Protection System. Meanwhile, during the validity period of [Ally Protection] granted by HAL9000, increases his Max HP Cap by 25% for every 1 ally protected by him.
Gear Axe Lv.3Reduces 15% DMG taken by allies with [Ally Protection] granted by Protection System. Increases HAL9000's Max HP Cap to 40% for every 1 ally protected by him.
